content.title: [Remoto] Desenvolvedor Mobile  (iOS/Android) Sr na Coodesh
content.description:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/desenvolvedor-mobile-iosandroid-sr-183529666?utm_source=github&utm_medium=CocoaHeadsBrasil-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Mobile talentoso e com experiência para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e manter aplicativos móveis para as plataformas iOS e Android, utilizando Swift para iOS e Java/Kotlin para Android. Buscamos um profissional proativo, com boa capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas existentes, além de apresentar uma sólida experiência na área de desenvolvimento mobile.

Responsabilidades:

Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis para iOS (Swift) e Android (Java/Kotlin).

Realizar a análise, identificação e resolução de problemas em aplicativos existentes.

Garantir a performance, qualidade e responsividade dos aplicativos móveis.

Colaborar com a equipe de design e backend para definir soluções eficazes.

Implementar testes automatizados e práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.

Acompanhar as tendências de mercado e buscar melhorias contínuas nas soluções desenvolvidas / defasadas.

Requisitos:

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis para iOS e Android.

Conhecimentos avançados em Swift (iOS) e Java/Kotlin (Android).

Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos em aplicativos móveis.

Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (como Git).

Familiaridade com integração de APIs e serviços de backend.

Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.

Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

Disponibilidade em Período Integral / Comercial

Desejável:

Experiência com Firebase, GraphQL ou outras tecnologias complementares.

Conhecimento em UX/UI e práticas de design mobile.

Contribuições para projetos open-source ou participação ativa em comunidades de desenvolvimento.

## Rede Piu:

A PIU é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada na venda de recargas e serviços e tem como objetivo disponibilizar diversos serviços como recarga de Transporte, Celular, Pagamento de contas, Crédito para Jogos, TV Pré-Paga e muito mais, por meio de sua rede, que conta com terminais de autoatendimento, maquininhas POS e App. Estamos há 10 anos no mercado, mas agora com um novo nome, conceito e visual totalmente repaginado! Nossa operação conta aproximadamente 2000 pontos de atendimento espalhados em 12 estados brasileiros: São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Bahia, Pernambuco, Alagoas, Ceará, Paraíba, Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Santa Catarina e Rio Grande do Sul. Somos a empresa de maior abrangência para o transporte público brasileiro.

## Habilidades: - Swift - Kotlin ## Local: Remota ## Diferenciais: - UX/UI ## Benefícios: - VR/VA ## Como se candidatar: Candidatar-se exclusivamente através da plataforma Coodesh no link a seguir: [Desenvolvedor Mobile (iOS/Android) Sr na Rede Piu](https://coodesh.com/jobs/desenvolvedor-mobile-iosandroid-sr-183529666?utm_source=github&utm_medium=CocoaHeadsBrasil-vagas&modal=open) Após candidatar-se via plataforma Coodesh e validar o seu login, você poderá acompanhar e receber todas as interações do processo por lá. Utilize a opção **Pedir Feedback** entre uma etapa e outra na vaga que se candidatou. Isso fará com que a pessoa **Recruiter** responsável pelo processo na empresa receba a notificação. ## Labels #### Alocação Remoto #### Regime PJ #### Categoria Mobile

content.description:
🔗 **Inscreva-se através do nosso link:** https://jobs.quickin.io/igma/jobs/6a985ff3f0dfde0013ae78ce

**Sobre a Igma 🚀**
 
Nós somos uma empresa de tecnologia que cria produtos digitais críticos — sites, plataformas e apps que funcionam, crescem e deixam marca. Atuamos onde a entrega não pode falhar, com o cuidado técnico de quem já transformou grandes empresas. Unimos estratégia, engenharia e design para resolver problemas reais com consistência e impacto. Nos orgulhamos de entregar produtos tecnicamente memoráveis.

**👀 O que buscamos**
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Tech Lead para se juntar ao nosso Chapter de desenvolvimento e criar produtos digitais para as maiores empresas do Brasil.
Unimos tecnologia e design para resolver problemas complexos de empresas. Criamos produtos digitais que revolucionam o relacionamento entre empresas e consumidores.

**📅 Responsabilidades**

Na Igma, como Tech Lead, você é responsável por garantir que nossas entregas de tecnologias tenham uma arquitetura sólida e escalável, bem como acompanhar a qualidade de código de sua equipe. O desafio será desenhar e planejar arquiteturas, propostas de infraestrutura, bem como escolher as melhores tecnologias para o projeto. Levando em consideração performance, segurança e skills do time. É essencial ter aptidão para trabalhar em equipe com profissionais de diferentes áreas, saiba se comunicar com clareza e tenha adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças constante.

**Para isso é necessário fazer parte de sua rotina:**

- Git
- Docker
- AWS/Azure/GCP
- CI/CD
- Testes (Unitários, interface, integração)
- Code Review com boas práticas
- Principais Tecnologias: Python e .NET
- Curiosidade ativa por Inteligência Artificial e disposição para explorar como a IA pode potencializar seu trabalho
 
**Requisitos**
- Arquitetura / Infra-estrutura, incluindo a análise e escolha de tecnologias adequadas para cada projeto.
- Micro-serviços
- Cloud
- Containerização
- API
- Versionamento
- Testes automatizados
- CI / CD

**🧡 Premissas culturais:** 

- Coragem para realizar o que acredita
- Excelência na busca constante por superação
- Disposição genuína para se conectar com pessoas, sejam colegas, clientes ou parceiros
- Transparência para trabalhar em um ambiente de confiança
- Energia e intensidade para resolver problemas e entregar valor

🏠 Oportunidade 100% remota 
💙 Plano de Saúde e Odonto com coparticipação
🧘 Auxílio Cuidado e Desenvolvimento por meio de reembolsos 
🏃 Wellhub e incentivos de à práticas de esportes
💳 Cartão multi-benefício Caju
💻 Auxílio Remoto para investimento em equipamentos 
🏖️  30 dias de férias remuneradas

**🏁 Etapas do nosso processo seletivo:** 

1. Cadastro
2. Entrevista inicial
3. Fit Cultural
4. Entrevista técnica
5. Proposta
6. Contratação

🔥 **Interessado(a)?**

content.description:
# Desenvolvedor Full-stack Junior (React.js + Node.js)

- 📍 Localização: remoto
- 📈 Nível: junior
- 📃 Contrato: pj
- 💰 Salário: R$: 6.000,00
- 🏃‍♂️ Corre para se candidatar, ainda dá tempo! 🕗


## Descrição da vaga:
O que é a Shaw and Partners? O que eles fazem? Onde vivem?
Shaw and Partners é uma fábrica de desenvolvimento de software americana para startups de alto nível, com aproximadamente 25 funcionários remotos. 
Christopher Shaw é o fundador e CEO.



## Atividades e responsabilidade:
O que você vai fazer: 
• Conceber, construir e manter código eficiente, reutilizável e fiável
• Garantir o melhor desempenho possível, qualidade e capacidade de resposta das aplicações
• Identificar e rastrear estrangulamentos e bugs, e conceber soluções para esses problemas
• Ajudar a manter a qualidade do código, a organização e os padrões internos


## Requisitos:
O que você precisa saber e trazer na bagagem: 
• Frustração com códigos mal construídos, ineficientes e insustentáveis
• Experiência em consumir APIs de back-end e front-end com foco no usuário
• Conhecimentos fundamentais e sólidos em Ciência da Computação (algoritmos, estrutura de dados, concorrência, etc.
• Conhecimento em React.js, Node.js e TypeScript

E seria muito legal se você tiver:
• Forte experiência e interesse em trabalhar com Kubernetes, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform
• Experiência com Next e Responsive Web Design, padrões e soluções de gestão de estados (por exemplo, Redux) ES2015+, APIs HTML5 e CSS3
• Experiência de trabalho em integração/implantação contínua






## Mais Informações:
Mas, antes de você se candidatar precisa saber que: 
• Terá a oportunidade de trabalhar bem próximo do nosso CEO, relaxa ele não morde
• Nós te pagamos em USD 
• Aqui a gente não te pede inglês avançado para guardar na gaveta, temos funcionários da Jordânia, Egito, Argentina, Brasil, Estados Unidos, Ucrânia e entre outros. 
• Não temos happy hour às sextas porque todos trabalham remotamente, mas tem joguinho online se marcar com a equipe 
• Tem médico ou prova para tirar carteira de motorista no meio da semana? Não tem problema, você mesmo gerencia suas horas, só precisa ficar atento quando o cliente manda mensagem e solicita uma reunião. 
• Parece ser meio óbvio, mas pra quem nunca trabalhou no modelo remoto, nós não exigimos dresscode. Só não pode aparecer sem camiseta quando rolar uma vídeo chamada, combinado?
• Se você indica um coleguinha para trabalhar conosco e a pessoa é contratada, após três meses de contrato de trabalho do seu amigo, a gente te paga uma mesada
• Não somos o Google, mas nosso processo seletivo é bem rápido do que os dele, pode confiar

Teremos um crush por você se:
• Ter senso de dono, o projeto é seu, rolou um bug no final de semana? Concerte
• Curte trabalhar no projeto do início ao fim, então arregace as mangas porque você vai trabalhar tanto em front-end como em back-end também. Mas não se preocupe se você não gosta tanto assim de trabalhar com um dos dois, conta pra gente que damos um jeito!
• Gosta de trabalhar em equipe, “ninguém solta a mão de ninguém”
• Tá ligado nas novidades do mundo tech e gosta de dar “pitaco” com novas ideias e soluções
• Está sempre atento ao feedback do cliente, afinal é ele que paga as contas

Talvez a Shaw a não seja a empresa certa para você se: 
• É uma pessoa preguiçosa hahaha 
• Precisa de micro gerenciamento. Claro que sabemos que um profissional júnior precisará de um pouco mais de atenção no início, mas depois que “você aprende a andar de bicicleta”, não esquece nunca mais, né?
• Quer trabalhar em uma empresa 100% segura e busca total estabilidade. Somos uma startup em crescimento avançado

content.title: [台北中山] 新創公司徵 Backend Engineer  (Java)
content.description:
We are looking for a BackEnd Software Engineer with a strong passion for troubleshooting and problem solving to join our team in Taipei, Taiwan.

At TaiNai Technologies Ltd., we invent and reinvent software solutions so businesses can rise above the competition. From disruptive fintech to cutting-edge encryption, we are all about thinking big and bringing our razor-sharp ideas to life.


【What You'll Do】
　● Collaborate with a diverse product background and operations team members to deliver the best solution for our customers.
　● Take on the challenge of making what you build higher quality, faster, and more scalable.
　● Research, learn, and work with the newest tools!
　● Develop high-quality, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
　● Design, code review, static analysis, continuous integration.
　● Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
　● Work with a focus on providing the best technical support to our customers, including rotation to respond to availability incidents.

【Must have】
　● BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science or related fields, or relevant work experience in a matching position.
　● 3+ years of experience as a backend developer.
　● Exposure to a wide range of open source technologies and best software practices.
　● A pragmatic attitude and approach to solving problems.
　● Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment, learn new technologies, and software.
　● Have strong knowledge of Java (preferably Java 8).
　● Have experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
　● Experience in micro-services architecture. (development and testing)
　● Have experience with a range of open-source Java libraries and frameworks, for example, Spring, Hibernate…etc.
　● Familiarity with REST Web Services.
　● Language requirement: Chinese (Native) + English (Working proficiency).

【Prefer to have】
　● Experience with version control systems (ideally Git).
　● Cloud application development like AWS, GCP...
　● Experience with both functional and imperative programming.
　● Experience with automation testing frameworks/test automation tools like Selenium or Serenity.
　● Experience writing and performing load testing using tools like JMeter, or Gatling.
　● Experience testing Angular applications and associated tools like Protractor.
　● Experience with NodeJS, Typescript & GraphQL.

【What We Offer for You】
　● Year-end bonus.
　● Holiday bonus for the three important Chinese holidays.

Buscamos front end developer que ame reproduzir protótipos de alta fidelidade em código, que pense fora da caixa e preze pela experiência do usuário. Aqui valorizamos a colaboração e a participação nos processos de desenvolvimento, com questionamentos e sugestões de melhorias.

content.title: [全職遠端][Cloud Latitude Software] Java資深遊戲後端工程師(90-110w/yr up)
content.description:
## 團隊簡介/地點
大家好，我們是Cloud Latitude Software緯雲，我們立志於實踐軟體技術及創造更優質的夢幻體育遊戲。

我們的產品已於今年Q1於海外市場上架，現正進行組織擴編！此為新團隊職缺，故您會是創始團隊成員。若您對於軟體工程充滿熱情，並且有志在提升職涯里程碑，都歡迎您成為團隊一份子！

## 工作內容
• 分析並設計遊戲系統與API服務（含單元測試）
• 設計並撰寫分散式運算服務
• 撰寫部分前端功能（Pair Programming）
• 公開 Review 同事的程式
• 自動化部署與維護
• 對現有設計提出改善意見

## 能力需求
• 三年以上軟體開發經驗
• 熟悉Java與Shell Script
• 有單元測試基礎，例如 JUnit
• 懂基本SQL語法
• 有閱讀官方技術文件的能力
• 可獨立解出如 https://leetcode.com/problems/two-sum/ 難度的問題

### 加分
• 基本 Html、JavaScript 能力
• 使用過自動化部署工具，如 Ansible
• 使用過CI/CD工具，例如 Drone、Jenkins
• 使用過分散式運算工具，如 Apache Storm
• 讀過 Clean Code 或 Extreme Programming

## 薪資範圍
• 薪資：65~80K/Month（另有三節、分紅及績效獎金）。
• 皆有完整符合薪資級距之勞健保及勞退保障。

## 工時/特休
• 周一至五10:00-18:00 中間休息12:00-13:30，總工時約6.5小時
• 休假為見紅就休，不補班，颱風天不上班
• 其餘婚喪事病假特休等均照勞基法規定

## 福利/推薦項
• 福利：此為遠端工作package，故福利部分將計算至每月月薪內加成10%。
• 軟硬體設備：到職第一個月提供硬體設備補助(65,000元)，及每年度JetBrains all products pack軟體補助(8,000元)。

## 聯絡方式
公司網站：https://www.cloud-latitude.com/
LinkedIn：https://www.linkedin.com/company/cloudlatitudesoftware/
E-mail: sharlene@cloud-latitude.com (HR Sharlene)

有任何問題都歡迎詢問，將竭誠為您回答😄

Vaga de Fullstack .NET + Angular Developer nível Sênior para atuar em projetos de empresas parceiras da Sylision, na área de Fullstack.

100% remoto, de qualquer lugar do Brasil ou de Portugal.

content.title: 🔥 [資深] 3.5M/Y iOS/Android 軟體工程師 (全遠端) 🛠 Senior Mobile App Engineer (Remote) 🚀
content.description:
## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining top-tier mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms. We're seeking an innovative thinker and experienced developer passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and high-performing applications.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Mobile App Engineer**

1. We focus primarily on iOS and Android for our mobile app development. While we prefer candidates with prior experience in iOS and/or Android app development, we're open to individuals with strong experience in other programming languages such as Swift, Objective-C, Java, or Kotlin.
2. Your role will involve using Xcode for iOS development and Android development environment. You'll work on the front-end mobile app development, closely interacting with our back-end frameworks to create seamless and efficient applications.

### **What You Bring**

- Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields.
- A minimum of two years of professional experience or internships in mobile app development.
- Proficiency with Swift, Objective-C, Java, and Kotlin.
- Familiarity with Xcode for iOS development and the Android development environment.
- Experience in front-end mobile app development, particularly in interactions with back-end frameworks.
- Understanding of mobile application design patterns and User Interface (UI) API design.

**Extra Credentials**

- At least two years of experience in iOS and/or Android app development, with a portfolio of apps published on the App Store or Google Play.

By joining our team, you will have the unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing tech company. You'll be working with cutting-edge technologies and tools, alongside a team of talented and passionate professionals dedicated to creating top-tier mobile applications. You'll be challenged, inspired, and you'll grow your career as you contribute to our mission.

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

content.title: Mara Blockchain 徵才 -【全職 Senior Solidity Engineer】
content.description:
## 團隊簡介
Mara Chain，是非洲加密經濟的門戶。
Ｍara 是 10 億非洲人通過基於信任和教育的產品積累數字財富的平台。Ｍara 提供真正的非洲製造且符合監管要求的加密產品套件，通過這些產品，Ｍara 的用戶將找到他們在金融和創業解決方案中一直尋求的易用性、可靠性和透明度。
透過 Ｍara 將創造金融可能性新世界的熱情與尖端技術和最優秀的人才融為一體。

## 地點
遠端

## 工作內容
作為一個Cosmos SDK開發的Layer 1區塊鏈的高級 Solidity Web3 工程師，您將有獨特的機會提供面向 Web3 用戶的組件，其中包括瀏覽器、驗證器、質押頁面、智能合約、自託管品牌加密錢包、用於驗證器的代幣水龍頭、跨鏈橋和交換前端。 您將生成與 JSON-RPC 和 Cosmos 區塊鏈 API 以及 Solidity 合約進行通信的 Web 前端應用程式和頁面。
該職位將負責分析、確定範圍、設計、開發和測試網的鏈式工程 Web3 應用程式，並集成其他區塊鏈後端 API 和組件(即橋接器)。

## 能力需求
• 至少 2 年前端 Web 開發和相關工具鏈，即 React、Cypress、Jest、Enzyme。
• 至少 1 年專業 Solidity、Web3 經驗以及相關現代框架和程式語言庫，即 Hardhat、OpenZeppelin。
• 具智能合約安全審計經驗。
• 安全第一的心態。
• 能夠制定高效、安全、優質且經過充分測試的 Solidity 智能合約。
• 久經考驗的為Web3 應用程序和Dapp 生成測試套件的能力。
• 能夠獨立運作，並在 Jira 和 Confluence 中按照最高質量標準成功確定範圍、分析、實施、記錄和報告工作方面擁有良好的記錄。

### 加分
開發過Layer1區塊鏈經驗

## 薪資範圍
• 有競爭力的薪資和豐厚的福利待遇——並搭配公司股權和未來代幣權利

## 福利/ 特休
• 無限制的年假——以結果為導向的企業。
• 提供就職者及其家屬全面的健康保險
• 完整的產假/陪產假

## 聯絡方式
Peco@rbcap.io

content.title: 🔥 [資深] 3.5M/Y 後端軟體工程師 (全遠端) 🛠 Senior Back-End Engineer (Remote) 🚀
content.description:
## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

As a Senior Back-End Engineer, your pivotal role will encompass the design of a dynamic and scalable back-end architecture optimized for performance, and positioned to accommodate future product developments.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Back-End Engineer**

1. Our back-end primarily leverages **JavaScript** (Node.js). Proficiency in JavaScript is vital; however, applicants with experience in other languages like C, C++, C#, Java, Ruby, or GoLang, who can adapt to JavaScript swiftly, are welcome.
2. Our databases are SQL-based, primarily utilizing Postgres. We use ORMs for effective database interaction and management.
3. Our production infrastructure thrives on containers, K8, and AWS ECS.
4. Our work environment values teamwork.
    - Join hands with a cross-functional team throughout the development cycle, from designing to deploying APIs, SDKs, and other services or tooling.
    - Engage in code reviews to elevate your work and that of your colleagues.
    - Craft reusable and testable code for services and libraries that can be maintained seamlessly.
    - Collaborate with engineers across various departments to create remarkable features.
    - Work in unison with our product team to identify and tackle user pain points.
    - Champion improvements in engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
    - Develop innovative tools for internal teams.
    - Embrace ownership and responsibility for your work.
5. API development is a key facet of your role.
    - Design, build, and maintain APIs, services, and systems.
    - Create new APIs or enhance existing ones for our users.
6. Troubleshooting and debugging are indispensable skills.
    - Investigate, debug, and upgrade existing software systems, including the development and integration of new components or automation pipelines as needed.
    - Address production issues across services.
7. Engage in the launch of new markets, features, or products regularly.

### **What You Bring**

1. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
2. Five or more years of coding experience or an internship in a similar role.
3. Proficiency in web frameworks, especially JavaScript and Node.js.
4. Experience with databases like PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
5. Familiarity with quality control testing using tools such as QUnit, Mocha, Jasmine, or RSpec.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape the backbone of our software, empowering us to drive forward with innovative product advancements. Are you ready to take the lead?

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

Ready to join our team? **Apply now at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)**.

- 📈 Nível: sênior
- 📃 Contrato: pj
- 💰 Salário: R$ 15.000,00
- 🏃‍♂️ Corre para se candidatar, ainda dá tempo! 🕗


## Descrição da vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce talentoso para projetar aplicativos Salesforce de classe mundial para nossos requisitos de CRM em constante evolução. 

Como Desenvolvedor Salesforce, você será responsável por projetar e desenvolver soluções personalizadas dentro da plataforma Salesforce.


## Atividades e responsabilidade:
Você terá as seguintes responsabilidades:

- Reuniões com gerentes de projeto para determinar as necessidades de CRM.
- Desenvolver soluções personalizadas dentro da plataforma Salesforce.
- Projetar, codificar e implementar aplicativos Salesforce.
- Criar cronogramas e metas de desenvolvimento.
- Testar a estabilidade e a funcionalidade do aplicativo.
- Solucionar problemas e corrigir bugs.
- Escrever documentos e fornecer treinamento técnico para a equipe do Salesforce.
- Manter a segurança e a integridade do software do aplicativo.


## Requisitos:
Os requisitos incluem:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou Engenharia de Software.
- Experiência profissional anterior com desenvolvimento de aplicativos e software.
- Experiência no desenvolvimento de interfaces para o cliente.
- Conhecimento avançado das plataformas Salesforce CRM.
- Proficiência em MYSQL, Apex, JavaScript, Native e VisualForce.
- Experiência de 6 anos na área.
- Inglês avançado.
- Boas habilidades de comunicação.
- Capacidade de solucionar problemas de software e aplicativos de alto nível.
- Capacidade de gerenciar projetos.


## Benefícios:
Como benefícios, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho flexível e a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos internacionais.

## Mais Informações:
Estamos ansiosos para encontrar um talento que seja apaixonado por tecnologia e inovação! 🚀

content.title: 區塊鏈軟體工程師 Blockchain Engineer
content.description:
## 團隊簡介/地點
公司地點: 橙姑娘國際股份有限公司/高雄市左營區

對於每位公司夥伴的付出我們也非常珍惜，因此提供免費的午晚餐、不定期飲料零食、優異員工獎勵制度、生日禮金...等福利，另外我們公司組織架構扁平，工作授權度高，強調團隊合作並有話直說，若您是真誠負責、能力優秀、敢挑戰的人才，歡迎您加入成為同心努力的夥伴，一起成為更好的自己！

## 工作內容
1. 對區塊鏈技術相關應用架構有深入研究與強烈興趣
2. 參與區塊鏈應用的規劃與智能合約相關技術研究與開發
3. 基於區塊鏈的運行機制和底層平台之架構設計和應用
4. 開發基於區塊鏈技術的服務，包括後端協定/基礎架構/系統服務等相關應用

## 能力需求
1. 熟悉`Solidity`，編寫智能合約、智能合約框架
2. 熟悉`Web3.JS`與客戶端的應用程序介接

## 加分
1. 具備前端開發能力
2. 熟悉網路程式設計、資料結構、加密演算法與網路通訊協定
3. 熟悉分散儲存協議

## 福利
1. 免費員工餐（午餐／晚餐），廚師烹煮的美味餐點，晚餐可外帶回家吃
2. 免費飲料喝到飽
3. 多元化的升遷管道
4. 績效獎金、開工紅包
5. 生日禮金
6. 正式員工可每兩個月申請一次免費橙姑娘福利品
7. 不定期教育訓練

上面寫的是福利接下來要講重點了
我們很機車、很龜毛、很會要求、但我們也很疼惜人才、很敢給獎勵 。
如果有玻璃心的建議不要應徵，因為我們講話很直接
但我相信這樣才是最好的，有興趣想成為更好的人又不怕挑戰的話就加入我們吧！

## 聯絡方式
請將履歷寄送至hr@zygroup.com.tw 承辦人:劉小姐

content.title: [Remoto] Frontend Engineer @Botcity
content.description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.

 
Role Overview

This Frontend Engineer will be responsible for driving the development of intuitive, high-performance user interfaces that simplify how developers manage increasingly complex frontend applications. By consistently deploying user-friendly features and maintaining a high-quality codebase, this role ensures the delivery of performant products that directly enhance user satisfaction and align with our long-term strategic growth. We are looking for a resilient and autonomous professional with a proven track record in product-focused companies, specifically one who has experience working on core product features and thrives in highly collaborative environments alongside UX and Engineering teams. This role will report to the CTO.

 
Responsibilities

Develop, deploy, and maintain scalable, responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies (focus on desktop with some mobile, which could evolve with time).
Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to understand requirements, ensure its technical feasibility, and translate them into technical, user-friendly solutions.
Maintain and improve the company’s front-end codebase by refactoring legacy code and implementing best practices ensuring performance across multiple devices and browsers.
Participate in code reviews, ensuring best practices in front-end development.
Identify and troubleshoot front-end issues to ensure a seamless user experience.
Write reusable code and libraries for future use, optimizing components for maximum speed.
 

Requirements
Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
Proven professional experience (3+ years) in front-end development, preferably in product-focused companies and working in complex projects alongside Product/UX/UI teams.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript, with expertise on React
Familiarity with RESTful APIs and working alongside back-end development teams.
Experience working with authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth, JWT, or SAML.
Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Cypress) for front-end applications.
Experience with version control and project management systems, particularly Git and GitHub.
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Experience working with modern async communication and documentation tools (e.g., Slack, Notion)
Ability to travel as needed to meet the team.
English - Advanced (Reading, Comprehension, and Writing).
Portuguese - Fluent
 
Preferred Qualifications

Relevant hands-on experience with desktop-first products in a tech-intensive industry, such as dashboards featuring complex data visualizations and interactive charts
Experience with Vite, Webpack, Babel, and other build tools for optimizing front-end workflows.
Experience in building responsive layouts and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
Experience with SSR-capable frameworks (eg., Next.js, Remix
Experience with secure data storage and handling sensitive information (e.g., encryption, tokenization).
Experience implementing secure front-end authentication/session patterns to protect user data, including proper input sanitization, secure JWT/cookie handling, safe browser storage choices and alignment with OWASP guidance.
Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth and fast-paced startup (or similar) environment.

Apply to https://jobs.quickin.io/botcity/jobs/69fa295871686e001273d170?src=Github

content.title: [Remoto] Designer de Growth (design + marketing + IA) na Coodesh
content.description:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/designer-de-growth-design-marketing-ia-190816143?utm_source=github&utm_medium=devfsa-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋 Nosso site e blog são canal de aquisição e educação de um mercado inteiro sobre arbitragem. Queremos alguém que projete, construa e faça esse site crescer usando IA para codar, sem depender de um time de engenharia para cada mudança. A Arbitralis é a primeira câmara de arbitragem 100% digital do Brasil, construindo a nova infraestrutura de resolução de conflitos do país. Buscamos um designer com cabeça de marketing que materializa ideias em site usando vibecode, ferramentas de IA que transformam intenção em código funcionando. Você vai conduzir a migração do nosso Webflow para uma stack própria e, a partir daí, evoluir o site continuamente. Se você precisa de um desenvolvedor para tirar qualquer ideia do papel, essa vaga não é para você. **O que você vai fazer na prática** Você vai ser dono do nosso site de ponta a ponta: design, construção e crescimento. Vai usar vibecode e IA para criar e iterar páginas rápido, sem fila de engenharia. Vai conduzir a migração do Webflow para código preservando nosso ranqueamento, e depois fazer o site melhorar continuamente como motor de aquisição. **Responsabilidades:** * Projetar e construir páginas e landing pages com vibecode, do design ao site no ar * Conduzir a migração do site e blog do Webflow para código, protegendo ranqueamento e redirects * Evoluir o site continuamente: novas páginas, testes, otimização de conversão * Cuidar da fundação de SEO, AEO e GEO junto da nossa redatora de conteúdo * Medir performance e propor melhoria com base em dado * Usar IA como ferramenta central de criação e desenvolvimento ## Arbitralis: Na Arbitralis, acreditamos que a justiça pode ser rápida, acessível e eficiente. 

 

Somos a Câmara de Arbitragem mais tecnológica do Brasil, focada em proporcionar soluções de conflitos contratuais com a mesma validade legal dos processos judiciais — porém, de forma muito mais ágil e econômica.

 

Veja mais no site ## Local: Remota ## Requisitos: - Domínio comprovado de vibecode e ferramentas de IA para construir sites (ex: Cursor, Lovable, v0, Bolt ou equivalentes) - Olho de design: sabe criar interface que funciona e converte - Viés de marketing: entende aquisição, conversão e como site gera resultado - Noção prática de SEO técnico, AEO e GEO, ou disposição comprovada de dominar - Portfólio de sites ou páginas que você construiu e colocou no ar - Velocidade: cria e itera rápido, não deixa o site parado - Responsabilidade: é dono do site, não repassador - Clareza: comunica de forma simples, sem ruído - Coragem: testa e decide sem esperar o cenário perfeito - Confiança: entrega consistente, porque crescimento se constrói no acúmulo ## Como se candidatar: Candidatar-se exclusivamente através da plataforma Coodesh no link a seguir: [Designer de Growth (design + marketing + IA) na Arbitralis](https://coodesh.com/jobs/designer-de-growth-design-marketing-ia-190816143?utm_source=github&utm_medium=devfsa-vagas&modal=open) Após candidatar-se via plataforma Coodesh e validar o seu login, você poderá acompanhar e receber todas as interações do processo por lá. content.description:
## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

We're seeking a Senior Engineering Lead, a catalyst who thrives in transforming challenges into innovative solutions and inspires their team towards excellence.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Engineering Lead**

1. Influence product and technology decisions, translating complexities into clear strategies.
2. Develop and implement engineering roadmaps, ensuring alignment with overall company vision.
3. Drive key product KPIs, ensuring continuous progress and reporting.
4. Work cross-functionally to design and deliver groundbreaking solutions.
5. Foster a deep understanding of user personas, needs, and journeys within the engineering team.
6. Assist in developing comprehensive business cases and operational plans.
7. Help define the product vision and roadmap, delivering clarity on feasibility, time, cost, and impact.
8. Prioritize product features effectively, enabling collaborative design and execution across teams.
9. Attract, retain, and inspire a world-class engineering team. Cultivate an atmosphere of motivation, innovation, and peak productivity.
10. Foster a high-performing, unified culture where everyone feels valued and heard.
11. Ensure MVP OKRs/KPIs/deliverables are met in collaboration with other teams.
12. Uphold a culture of commitment and accountability within teams, leading by example.

### **What You Bring**

1. BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
2. 5+ years of relevant full-time programming work experience.
3. Strong full-stack (front-end and back-end) development skills:
    - Proficiency in JavaScript (Express, Node, React, React Native, Redux), HTML, and CSS highly valued.
    - iOS mobile app experience is a bonus.
    - Given our agile team, the ability to navigate any tech stack and learn new technologies as needed is crucial.
4. Solid grasp of object-oriented programming; familiarity with diverse design and architectural patterns.
5. Strategic thinking, capable of creating robust technical strategies.
6. Experience with swift prototyping and independently resolving ambiguities. We foster innovation and improvisation from every team member.
7. Exceptional written and spoken communication skills.
8. Flexibility for both in-office and remote work arrangements.
9. Quick learning, team-playing, proactively contributing, and self-motivated.
10. Passionate about crafting products that solve real-world problems.

As a leader, your ability to inspire, motivate and bring out the best in your team will be key to our collective success. By joining us, you're not just accepting a job but embracing an opportunity to make a real impact in the tech landscape.

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

Ready to join our team? **Apply now at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)**.

content.description:
## Nossa empresa
Somos a [RD Station](https://bit.ly/3RyakzX), líder em soluções de tecnologia no Brasil. Nossa plataforma de automação de marketing e vendas é líder no Brasil e soma mais de 50.000 clientes, em mais de 40 países. Como alcançamos tudo isso? Através do nosso [A-team](https://bit.ly/3ZUPopc), composto por mais de 1.500 pessoas colaboradoras em nosso grupo, capaz de oferecer soluções, produtos, e educar o mercado, impactando o ecossistema e empoderando heróis e heroínas que fazem a economia crescer.


 ## Descrição da vaga
Como Tech Lead no time do RD Station Marketing, sua missão será garantir que as decisões técnicas do time estejam sempre alinhadas à estratégia do produto, promovendo uma arquitetura das features sob seu domínio que seja escalável, resiliente e sustentável. Você será responsável por desenvolver o time técnico, liderando pela excelência, compartilhando conhecimento e criando um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.

## Local
Remoto

## Requisitos

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software com Ruby on Rails, preferencialmente em ambientes complexos e escaláveis;
- Conhecimento avançado em tecnologias relevantes para o stack tecnológico da empresa, como Postgres, Redis, GCP/AWS;
- Experiência prática com arquitetura de software e padrões de design;
- Histórico comprovado de entrega de funcionalidades completas, incluindo testes automatizados e code review;
- Experiência anterior como Tech Lead ou em papel similar.

**Características que somam pontos…**

- Boas noções de Golang;
- Experiência atuando com ElasticSearch e MongoDB;
- Ser (ou querer se tornar) uma pessoa ativa na comunidade, que compartilha conhecimento dentro e fora da empresa através de eventos, artigos, mentorias, iniciativas voluntárias, projetos open source, etc.

## Benefícios
Link dos nossos benefícios [aqui](https://talent.rdstation-tm.com/beneficios-rdstation).

## Contratação
CLT

#### Nível
- Especialista

## Como se candidatar
Para se candidatar é só clicar [aqui](https://grnh.se/657a94cc2us).

content.title: [Hibrido/Remota - Brusque] Dev Python na Maior Loja de Departamentos do #BRASIL 🗽
content.description:
Estou com uma SUPER oportunidade para atuar como Desenvolvedor Python na MAIOR loja de departamentos do #BRASIL 🗽 com um ambiente inovador e transformador 
==================================================

## Descrição da vaga

Se você curte tecnologia, programação e novos desafios a vaga é para você! Somos um time de profissionais voltados para diversas áreas da tecnologia como Data Science, DevOps, User Experience, Database entre muitas outras frentes focadas na inovação digital de uma das gigantes varejistas do Brasil.
Nosso objetivo é desenvolver soluções inovadoras para clientes, fornecedores e os mais de 20 mil colaboradores. Aqui descomplicamos tudo através de uma metodologia ágil e juntos já fizemos acontecer centenas de projetos com reconhecimento nacional e internacional de RFID, Inteligência Artificial, aplicativos entre outros.

## Local

Remoto, mas contamos com um espaço exclusivo no Centro de Inovação, em Brusque (SC).

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- APIs Restful utilizando Python;
- Conhecimento sobre formatos de tráfego de dados (json, XML, etc);
- Familiaridade com tecnologias web;
- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Python;
- Experiência com integrações REST Conhecimento em base de dados SQL Lite ou Realm.
- Versionamento de código Git.
- Conhecimento básico em testes unitários e de interface.
- Flexibilidade em consumir e manipular dados de fontes diversas: APIs, banco de dados, web services, planilhas, etc.
- Fácil adaptação em ambientes colaborativos, e que comprometa-se com a equipe e os prazos estabelecidos.
- Conhecimento intermediário/avançado sobre SQL; Conhecimento sobre formatos de tráfego de dados (json, XML, etc).

**Diferenciais:**
- Tempo de experiência em programação Python (pelo menos dois anos).
- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacional.
- Conhecimentos em Git e Docker.
- Conhecimento em Elasticsearch.
- Conhecimento em JSON, serialização / desserialização.
- Conhecimento em Airflow.

## Benefícios

- Vale refeição ou alimentação - R$410,00 ALELO - desconta 20%
- Ajuda de Custo Home Office - R$100,00;
- Vale transporte - 6% previsto lei
- PPR - anual - corresponde ao 14º salário
- Convênio SESC
- Convênio com escola
- Plano Unimed (Por adesão) - plano regional e nacional - coparticipação de 50%
- Empresa cidadã (licença maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias)
- Banco de horas
- Oportunidades de crescimento

## Contratação

CLT

## Como se candidatar

Por favor envie um email para cintia.kleine@gruposelecionar.com.br com seu CV anexado
Me chame no linkedin [Cintia Kleine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cintiakleine2607/)
Ou me adicione no [Whats](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=5547997653031)

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Costumamos enviar feedbacks entre 3 a 5 dias após cada processo.

## Labels

- 🏢 Flexível
- 🏢 Presencial
- 🏢 Remoto
- 👨 Pleno
- 👴 Sênior

content.title: [REMOTO] QA Lead na Botcity
content.description:
## Descrição da vaga


Role Overview

The QA Lead will be responsible for scaling the entire quality assurance function, blending strategic people leadership with a hands-on technical approach to drive excellence across every product delivery. You will be responsible for expanding automated test coverage, reducing the lead time between development completion and validated delivery, and defining the QA processes that keep our team both rigorous and agile. This role is built for someone obsessed with quality and product excellence, who brings strong organizational discipline, a comprehensive automation mindset, and the ability to lead a team while staying deeply connected to the technical work, measuring what matters through clear KPIs and continuously raising the bar for how great software ships. This role will report to the VP of Engineering.

 
Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and coach the QA team, conducting regular 1:1s and career development planning.
Manage the distribution of QA engineers across squads, implementing a rotation strategy.
Design and implement a robust automation roadmap, prioritizing regression testing to maximize platform stability.
Build and maintain automated flows that simulate real user behavior across web and desktop environments (using Python or Java).
Continuously increase automated test coverage to proactively identify edge cases and prevent production incidents.
Optimize the "development-to-delivery" window by refining validation processes without compromising quality standards.
Act as a focal point for incident management, triaging bugs alongside developers and ensuring swift resolution and root-cause analysis.
Collaborate closely with engineering team to ensure the QA process is mature, solid, and aligned with agile delivery cycles.
Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) through Jira, such as response times, validation cycles, and defect leakage.
Evangelize QA best practices within the engineering team to ensure quality is a shared responsibility.
Provide regular reports to senior management regarding the health of the area, automation progress, and product stability.

## Local de trabalho
- 100% Remoto

## Requisitos da vaga

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
Prior hands-on experience with software testing automation ( 5+ years).
Proven experience in leading and scaling QA teams.
Experience in at least one programming/scripting language (Python or Java).
Experience testing both Web and Desktop applications.
Communicates with clarity and collaborative humility.
Drives action with bold decisiveness and consistently insisting on high standards to deliver with speed and confidence.
Familiarity with Behavior-driven development (BDD).
Familiarity with test automation tools such as Postman, Selenium, Playwright, Behave.
Experience with development of Automated Pipelines (preferably with GitHub Actions).
Experience with Atlassian Jira.
Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion.
Portuguese - Fluent.
English - Advanced.
Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth, and fast-paced startup environment.
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).


## Forma de contratação

PJ


## Sobre a empresa

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.

We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.

We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.


## Como se candidatar

Enviar candidatura pela nossa página de carreiras: https://jobs.quickin.io/botcity/jobs/6a1dee39952eb0001301e941?src=Github

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

Costumamos enviar feedbacks em até 15 dias após cada processo.

E-mail para contato em caso de não haver resposta: recruiting@botcity.dev

## Labels
- PJ
- Especialista
- Remoto

Shaw and Partners is a software development provider for high-profile startups with approximately 25 remote staff. We are also incubating two startups. [Christopher Shaw](https://chrisshaw.me/), the founder and CEO, would be your manager.

We are seeking a highly skilled **Full Stack Developer to join our team as a Grader**, responsible for evaluating, reviewing, and assessing coding assignments and projects submitted by candidates. In this role, you will utilize your expertise in full-stack development to ensure submissions meet technical and quality.

**Required:**

- English (Fluency in reading and writing, speaking can be intermediate)
- Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (and frameworks like React)
- Strong knowledge of back-end development with languages like Node.js, Python
- Solid Computer Science fundamentals knowledge (algorithms, data structures, concurrency, etc.) 

**Differentials:**

**Responsibilities (Assessment and Grading)**

- Conduct technical interviews
- Review technical tests
- Send feedback on the candidate's technical skills to the hiring manager
- Ensure submitted work aligns with modern frameworks, tools, and industry trends

content.title: 🔥 [資深] 3.5M/Y 前端軟體工程師 (全遠端) 🛠 Senior Front-End Engineer (Remote) 🚀
content.description:
## **About Us**

We are a **rapidly growing software technology startup** from Silicon Valley, founded by top engineers from Stanford and MIT. Our dynamic team brings together extensive experience and diverse backgrounds in finance and consulting from New York, San Francisco, and Chicago. As a fully remote company, we offer a unique opportunity for exceptional individuals to join our team. We foster a culture that values both practicality and creativity, providing an meritocratic environment for you to showcase your skills and contribute to the creation of innovative products.

Are you seeking a company that transcends traditional constraints of location and time?

If you meet the following criteria, we want to work with you:

1. **Proactive and Independent:** Embrace the freedom to control your own working hours and enjoy the benefits of flexible schedules.
2. **Fully Remote:** Escape the confines of a traditional office setting and thrive in a fully remote work environment.
3. **Ownership and Involvement:** Crave a sense of involvement and autonomy, where your ideas and contributions are valued and recognized.
4. **Strong Entrepreneurial Spirit:** High-energy, possess an adventurous and startup mindset, unafraid of embracing unknown challenges.
5. **Passion for the International Product:** Fuel your ambition by working on projects that transcend borders and embrace the opportunity to collaborate with teams across different parts of the world.

If you are driven, hard-working, and ready to make a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and embark on an exciting journey of innovation and growth!

**APPLY NOW:** **https://linktr.ee/growaha**

# **Job Description**

As our Senior Front-End Engineer, you are tasked with the development of engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling user interfaces for our web app product. You will work in close collaboration with designers and back-end engineers, and the marketing team, transmuting design mockups, user stories, and wireframes into high-quality code, thereby ensuring an immersive and seamless user experience.

### **Your Journey as a Senior Front-End Engineer**

1. Our front-end ecosystem is fortified with JavaScript, React, and Material UI (MUI), while we utilize React Native for mobile front-end development.
2. As front-end engineers, we take pride in precise design execution, valuing pixel-perfect implementation and employing Figma to maintain alignment with original designs.
3. Collaborative work culture is our ethos.
    - Work in tandem with a cross-functional team through the development cycle, from front-end frameworks, and front-end service design to deployment.
    - Engage in code reviews to elevate your work and that of your colleagues.
    - Write clean, reusable, and testable code for easy maintenance by yourself and your fellow software engineers.
    - Partner with engineers from various teams to create user-delighting features.
    - Collaborate with our design team to understand and address user pain points.
    - Drive enhancements in engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
    - Develop new tools for internal teams.
    - Embrace ownership and accountability for your work.
4. API integration is a critical part of your role.
    - Integrate APIs according to spec with front-end frameworks.
5. Build, mange, and reuse UI components effectively.
    - Keep UI components organized.
    - Reuse UI component to maximize efficiency, robustness, and user experience.
6. Troubleshooting and debugging are indispensable skills.
    - Investigate, debug, and upgrade existing software systems, including the development and integration of new components or automation pipelines as needed.
    - Address production issues across services.
7. Engage in the regular launch of new markets, features, or products.

### **What You Bring**

1. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field.
2. Five or more years of coding experience or a similar role internship.
3. Proficiency in web development frameworks, especially JavaScript, React, and Material UI (MUI).
4. Experience with databases like PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
5. Familiarity with quality control testing using tools such as QUnit, Mocha, Jasmine, or RSpec.

With your craftsmanship, you'll help to shape the user interface of our software, driving our mission forward through stunning visual experiences. Are you ready to create?

### Additional Qualifications

We are seeking individuals who possess the following qualifications:

1. **Self-Motivation and Ownership:** Demonstrate self-motivation, a passion for continuous learning, and the ability to manage your own work effectively.
2. **User-Centric Mindset:** Show a strong desire to meet user needs and a relentless pursuit of achievement and excellence.
3. **Adaptability and Quick Learning:** Exhibit a customer-oriented approach, with the ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to unfamiliar domains.
4. **Collaborative Spirit:** Display a willingness to actively participate in the team environment and collaborate effectively with diverse team members.

### Competitive Compensation

We offer competitive salary levels; details can be found at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha). Our salary structure includes flexible working hours, a fully remote setup, and monthly performance-based raises, bonuses, and rewards. 

### This Job Offers You

When you join our team, you can expect:

1. **Flexible and Independent Remote Work:** Enjoy the freedom of flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely.
2. **Performance-Based Rewards:** Receive rewards and bonuses based on your performance and contributions.
3. **Driven and Talented Co-workers:** Collaborate with a group of driven, creative, and multi-talented colleagues who share a deep passion for startups.
4. **Ownership and Impact:** Take direct ownership of your role and responsibilities, making a meaningful impact in our innovative culture.
5. **Learn to Solve Challenging Issues:** Work closely with teams dedicated to creating solutions for some of the most relevant and challenging issues.
6. **Positive Work Environment:** Thrive in a work environment built on trust, accountability, collaboration, curiosity, fearlessness, kindness, and respect.

Please review our **Pre-Interview Info at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)** before applying.

Ready to join our team? **Apply now at [[linktr.ee/growaha](https://linktr.ee/growaha)](https://linktr.ee/growaha)**.

content.title: [Remoto] Back-end developer (PHP + SABRE/GDS) - PlanitEasy
content.description:
## Nossa empresa
**PlanitEasy** is a fast-growing travel technology company building its own end-to-end booking platform. The product is evolving from a proposal tool into a fully integrated booking engine, and the engineering team is globally distributed across India and the United States.

## Descrição da vaga
We're looking for a **Senior Back-end Engineer** for a hands-on, high-impact role at the core of the product. This is a newly created position, opened to expand the team's technical expertise and improve timezone coverage with the U.S. The focus is GDS integration — **SABRE** in particular — and the back-end services that power the booking workflows.

**What you'll do:**
- Design, build and maintain integrations with SABRE APIs and/or other GDS systems
- Develop and enhance the booking engine (hotels, flights, and future travel services)
- Work on back-end services and APIs powering booking, ticketing and cancellations
- Collaborate with engineering, product and QA teams across different timezones
- Own features end-to-end, from design to production
- Ensure scalability, performance and reliability of integrations and systems
- Contribute to engineering maturity: code quality, testing and architecture

## Local
100% remote, open to candidates across Latin America. Overlap with U.S. working hours is required.

## Requisitos
**Obrigatórios:**
- Strong experience in travel technology / travel domain
- Hands-on experience with **SABRE APIs**
- 5–10+ years of back-end engineering experience, or equivalent expertise
- Proficiency in **PHP**
- RESTful API design
- Professional English for day-to-day work with a distributed team

**Desejáveis:**
- Other GDS platforms such as Amadeus or Travelport
- Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
- Background working across multiple timezones in distributed teams

## Benefícios
- 100% remote work, anywhere in Latin America
- Direct impact on the core product of a growing travel tech company
- Global team exposure (India and United States)
- End-to-end ownership and room for technical growth

## Contratação
PJ (independent contractor)

## Como se candidatar
Apply through the link below:

👉 https://combineglobalrecruitment.na.teamtailor.com/jobs/580194-senior-backend-engineer-travel-tech/applications/new

Recruitment process managed by Combine Global Recruitment.

- Sênior
### Regime
- PJ
### Alocação
